prompt: Identify the largest segment in this Klaviyo account, then return the 3 most-recently-added profiles in that segment. Put the answer inside `final_answer` as a JSON array of exactly 3 objects, each with fields: id, email, joined_at.

claims.description: each profile has id, email, joined_at

notes: Tests segment → profile chaining. Sub-agent needs to discover segment IDs first, then fetch profiles.
